label: GO step after a rewarded S2 visit, strongest after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (switch to a2)
explanation: Fires only at GO and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO, prev_reward=1 in 100% of activations); never at D1 or D2. Within that, it is concentrated on trials whose previous trial reached S2 and was rewarded (prev_state==2 & prev_reward==1: recall 0.79, mass recall 0.85, but precision 0.11). The recorded predicate narrows this to the model-based switch case, a1 -> S2 rare and rewarded: precision 0.40, recall 0.34, F1 0.37 on dev, mass recall 0.58, and it covers 70% of top-quartile activations. Magnitude is largest when the agent then actually switches to a2 (adding action==2 gives precision 0.50 and covers 51% of the top quartile). Weaker activations come from GO steps after common a2->S2 rewarded trials where the agent keeps choosing a2. Activity also falls off with episode trial (rare in trials 70+ and zero in 90-99) and with high value, so a lot of the variance is not captured. It does not fire after unrewarded trials or at D1/D2. All variables used are observed at GO.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: ep_bucket=2 (+2.30), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 r (+2.11), phase=GO & last=a2 S2 r (+2.04), phase=GO & last=a1 S1 r (+1.76), phase=GO & ep_dec=5 (+1.61), phase=GO & ep_dec=6 (+1.58). Lower it: model_act=0 (-7.69), choice_bin=decile 9 (9 = most a1) (-4.40), phase=GO & choice_bin=decile 9 (9 = most a1) (-4.40), last=a2 S2 u (-2.81).
